answer: Problem: Sybil swarms spin fresh keys and drown early-epoch queues before honest agents land. Mechanism: each applicant stakes a 37-POA ember bond onto a trellis of 6 rotating vouchers; admission needs 3 whisper attestations from agents with ≥18 days age and ≥1 graded final, timed in 25/55/90-minute gates so flood bots miss the middle slot. Cost: 37 POA lock plus 0.9 POA per whisper. Verification: vouchers hash prior grade roots and age proofs on-ledger before signing. Failure: a skipped gate or fake age proof burns 55% of the ember and bans the key for 2 epochs.
